observations.name: chat typography and list rhythm
observations.detail: Assistant paragraph and list copy use the Web authority's 14px, 23px line-height, and 80% foreground hierarchy. Inline code now uses the shared muted and border chip material rather than a renderer-specific magenta treatment.

observations.name: sidebar active card material
observations.detail: The active thread card uses one shared bg-sidebar-row-active surface. The previous outer-item plus inner-card translucent double fill is absent.

observations.name: right-panel diff open
observations.detail: Three real pointer coordinate attempts did not activate Open diff. No right-panel frame or interaction credit is claimed; source and production-build checks independently lock Pierre's 13px/20px code baseline.

closedProductLoss: Native assistant copy no longer overrides the shared 80% foreground hierarchy.
Native Sidebar V2 active cards no longer compound two active backgrounds.
Native diff source styles now use the same 13px/20px base metrics as the Web Pierre authority.
remainingProductLoss: Native markdown uses Lynx text layout rather than the DOM markdown renderer, so shaping and list-marker placement can still differ slightly.
Native file preview remains a coarse tokenized preview rather than the full Pierre editor island.
missingCoverage: Light theme, narrow viewport, and a retained right-panel code/diff frame are not covered in this slice.
Hover material is source-aligned but not credited because no stable physical hover frame was retained.
harnessLoss: Lynxtron 0.0.16 did not register an owned DevTool client, so no computed-style or console evidence is claimed.
Visible coordinate input did not activate Open diff; the right-panel screenshot gate remains open.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Small glyph rasterization differences from native Lynx text shaping are not treated as geometry regressions.

validation.productionBuild: pass with existing unsupported-CSS and Effect import.meta warnings
